Have materials to sell? Offer them to BMS.

Farmers, farmer associations, collectors and other suppliers are welcome. No formal documents are needed to make a first enquiry.

  1. Tell us what you haveMaterial, rough quantity and where it is.
  2. BMS reviews itWe check whether it matches what buyers ask for.
